_about: Which devices' screenshots the site publishes, and from which screens.yml run. iPad images before run 15 are wrong (run 12: rotated by an EXIF tag; run 13: a cropped square, part black). Platform's fix (0616379, checked by the editor in Chromium on run 14: upright, whole screen) reaches dev at the next merge, so iPad is published only from run 15 on. Any PNG with an EXIF orientation other than 1 is left out regardless.
